entities.name: Query protein bL17
observations: The 123-residue sequence exactly matches a reviewed Staphylococcus haemolyticus bL17 reference sequence; homology identity and coverage are 100%.
A Pfam Ribosomal_L17 domain (PF01196.25) spans residues 16–122 with i-Evalue 1.3e-37.
The sequence has predicted molecular weight 13,819.639 Da and theoretical pI 9.687.
Close reviewed homologs are annotated as components of the 50S ribosomal subunit that contact protein L32.
The protein is annotated as a structural constituent of the ribosome and involved in translation.
The inferred cellular location is the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit; no signal peptide or membrane-targeting feature is indicated by the sequence analysis.

entities.name: 50S ribosomal protein bL17
observations: Reviewed bacterial homologs Q4L887, A7X5C3, and A6U3U8 support the bL17 identity.
GO annotations include GO:0022625 (cytosolic large ribosomal subunit), GO:0003735 (structural constituent of ribosome), and GO:0006412 (translation).

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: bL17 participates in protein synthesis as a structural component of the bacterial 50S ribosomal subunit.

entities.name: Cytosolic large ribosomal subunit
observations: The protein is localized to the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit according to reviewed homolog annotations.
